question: How should GCC fragrance and candle buyers shortlist custom paper tube packaging suppliers?
answer_blocks: GCC fragrance and candle buyers should shortlist suppliers by checking whether they can review diameter, height, product weight, cap structure, finish direction, artwork status and sample fit questions.
Paper tube packaging can work for candles, fragrance, cosmetics, tea and specialty retail products when the product weight and closure style are reviewed early.
MUGE PACKAGING supports custom paper tube packaging by diameter, height, cap structure, material, printing and finishing direction for project-specific review.
rfq_checklist: Tube diameter, height and product weight
Retail display and shipping handling context
Separate review for any compliance or document request
claim_boundaries: No FSC, FDA, food-contact or regulatory compliance guarantee
Project-specific quotation, documents and schedule require manual review
